props.name: direction
props.description: The shimmer's direction. Reversed for a right-to-left reading context, set by the consumer because the component does not know its locale.

props.name: variant
props.description: The shape being promised. `text` is a full-width line with the body line height, `circle` is a square bounding box with the full radius (a shape, not a style — same ruling as the Badge dot), `rect` is whatever box the consumer sizes.

ai.summary: A grey placeholder in the shape of content that is loading, so the page does not shift when the content arrives.
whenToUse: Content is loading into a known layout and the space must be held
A list, table, or card grid is fetching and the shape of what arrives is already known
whenNotToUse: An operation's duration matters — use a Spinner or Progress
The placeholder would be on screen more than a moment or two — show a real empty state instead
ai.accessibility: `aria-hidden` by design: a skeleton is scaffolding, not content, and announcing five grey rectangles before a table loads is noise. There is no `label` prop on purpose — if a region needs announcing while it loads, that is a live region and the consumer owns it. Real content announces itself when it arrives. Dimensions are the feature: every variant sets a default size the consumer overrides, because a skeleton that guesses the content's height causes the very layout shift it exists to prevent. Under reduced motion the shimmer is removed entirely rather than slowed — a slower shimmer is still motion, and the grey shape is the whole message.
knownLimitations: No slot by design: real content replaces the element, not its children
`direction` is a prop, not auto-detected — the component does not know its locale
